dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: Hmph, looks like I've got a knack for wrestling! Come on, one more round!

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! I'm Kabewa, a wres... No, I should say priest, from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: Ahem... I'm here to research volcanic history. But, research can get a little dull at times, so I signed up for this class to let my hair down and keep fit!

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: Never mind how poring over woven scrolls doesn't hold a candle to the thrill of throwing another per... No, err... I mean, inspiration must be honed, and so too must the body. Only through elevating both can one be complete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: Alright, take care of yourself! I'll continue with my wres... Ahem, sorry, no — May the Night-Wind protect you on your path, outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Umm, then what about your research into volcanic history?

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: U—Uh, well, I've... certainly been looking into it! For example, there seems to be some sort of connection between volcanoes and wrestling moves...

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: "Up to the present day, history has been shaped by the struggles of all living beings. Wrestling, then, is no less than the very rhythm of history." So say the scrolls left behind by the priest-king Maghan...

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: ...Ah no, sorry, there's... no actual evidence he ever said that. I think Grand Master Sanhaj might have just made that one up...

dialogues.speaker: Kabewa
dialogues.text: In any case, "contention" is undeniably a key part of Natlan's history, so studying wrestling is definitely... meaningful!
